headline: US Congress implements largest-ever export control upgrade against China, escalating tech war.
summary: This regulatory shift significantly tightens restrictions on technology transfer, directly impacting global semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure development, and tech supply chain logistics. The move intensifies geopolitical tensions and forces companies worldwide to reassess their operational strategies and market access with China.
